title: security: rbac v2 - fix KMS region residency audit logging and enforce region pinning for service keys
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Fix: RBAC v2 audit now records KMS key region and enforces region pinning for service-created keys. Backfill: small migration to populate missing audit entries.
description:
Motivation: RBAC v2 audit logs were not reliably recording the KMS key region for operations that created or rotated service keys. This caused gaps in data-residency investigations and made automated region pinning enforcement unreliable. This PR fixes the audit emission path, adds enforcement checks for KMS region residency on service key creation, and includes a small backfill/migration for recent audit entries. Changes are careful to avoid blocking existing stable code paths and include feature-flag gating for the enforcement portion.

What I changed: Updated the RBAC v2 KMS integration to include region metadata on all audit events, added server-side validation to enforce region pinning when the customer org has residency policies, implemented a backfill script that reprocesses audit rows with missing region fields (limited to last 30 days by default), and added unit/integration tests. Documentation updated with an operations note for the migration.

Why this is safe: Audit-only path is enabled by default (no enforcement) and has full test coverage. Enforcement is behind a feature flag flagged as "kms_region_enforce" and will be enabled for a pilot account first. The migration script is async and idempotent. CI covers lint/build/unit/integration; manual staging run was performed against a copy of the audit DB.

Related: ENG-9876, SEC-214, SUP-4321.

Notes: There is a small rolling migration window; ops should monitor the audit-residency-dashboard while the backfill runs.
